sources.title: Kyujanggak GK03269 first-party modern curatorial interpretation: Goryeosa tentative December 1452 printing and post-October 1453 broad circulation
sources.provider: Seoul National University Kyujanggak Korean Studies Institute / official catalog interpretive essay
sources.quality_notes: The official GK03269 basic commentary explicitly proposes December 1452 print without knowing movable versus block and suggests broad circulation after October 1453; both retrospective and tentative. Contemporary officially transcribed 1454-10-13 annal reports earlier limited palace-only complete history and new permission for wide distribution. This is a dating/interpretation tension, not direct manuscript/printed-original proof. Different physical item from GK03539. No target D16/D18 image and no independent physical glyph vote.
